# Serving fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

Generated by `scripts/make_serving_fixtures.py` from `tests/fixtures/reference_cases.json`.
Synthetic vessels (MMSI prefix `99`) on the two project port IDs. They verify import, publication,
update and dashboard behaviour only; they are not evidence of real vessel activity.

- `generation_a/` - complete batch artifact (manifest + visits.jsonl).
- `generation_b/` - same input plus one late observation that bridges a long-gap split.
- `provisional_updates.json` - ordered cohort updates with expected outcomes (applied, retry ignored, conflicting reuse of a sequence, delete, late stale update rejected, replacement snapshot).
